gen-gf-baumans-gf-gentium-book-plus: Gentium Book Plus reads like a text serif with its door left ajar, light horizontals and gentle thicks and thins. Baumans is the loud one, bold tubes with no thin strokes at all.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-inria-serif: Baumans draws every stroke at a single track width, like a neon tube, with a crescent-wrench c up front. Inria Serif follows in a dignified text serif.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-joan: Commanding is how Baumans looks, every stroke the same weight with no thin hairlines to vanish. Joan brings the soft brush-pressed shifts and a c you can see right into.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-junge: Baumans has the uniform line of a technical drawing pen. Junge adds a dignified serif with generous curve gaps and only slight tapering, so the two sit together without fighting.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kameron: Tubular, wrench-mouthed letters up top. Kameron lets its serif curves lighten mildly toward the ends, while Baumans keeps a ballpoint-pen line that would look thin if shrunk down.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lustria: Baumans rings out with round o shapes whose walls never vary. Lustria, a serif, adds present but undramatic weight changes and a wide-mouthed a, which gives the pair its grounded authority.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-maitree: Dignified and classic describes Maitree, a text serif with open curves. Under Baumans, those wire-like letters, it reads with a measured swell from hairline to stem.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-martel: Classic and editorial, Martel keeps a moderate contrast and horseshoe-open apertures. Give Martel a comfortable size, since Baumans already holds the page with strokes that never swell or thin.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mate-sc: Mate SC reads like a text serif with a faint nib pressure and brush-lifted ends. And Baumans, with its flat unvarying line, makes that mild thick and thin feel like quiet handwriting.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-serif-tc: Noto Serif TC reads as a classic serif with stems barely heavier than their arms. And Baumans, glass tubing bent into letters, makes its pen-like bowls feel gently hand-drawn.
